evidence.locator: The raster register is found in the VIC-II chip at location 53266
evidence.claim: The VIC-II raster register at $D012 is what this program reads to time the display.

evidence.locator: the screen memory location is set to $0400
evidence.claim: Screen memory sits at $0400 after power-on, which is where this program writes characters.

evidence.locator: The 1000 bytes of color memory starts at 55296
evidence.claim: Colour RAM is a separate 1000-byte region at $D800, written independently of screen memory.
The SID occupies $D400 upwards, the registers this program's title jingle drives.

firmware.guidance: Supply legally obtained C64 KERNAL, BASIC and character ROMs at the paths above. No ROM is ever copied into the report.
firmware.note: Three ROMs, so no single hash pins the machine. As with the Spectrum, emu198x-c64 resolves these itself rather than taking them as arguments, so the proof verifies the ROMs the emulator will load. See emu198x/emu198x#842.
